purpose: Exploratory development-only spending direction diagnostics; not causal evidence, independent validation, or candidate accuracy.
limitations: Sign consistency among positive amounts does not establish global conditional monotonicity or causality.
Zero-to-positive marginal reversals may reflect age and other spending differences; exploratory adulthood/other-spending stratification did not establish a robust conditional reversal.
Known CryoSleep=True development rows had no observed positive spending, so these data cannot identify a spending direction in that state.
The same development data have already been used for many exploratory decisions.

frozen_experiment.spatial_expert: Unchanged v34 eligibility, knots5, C.1, weight.5
frozen_experiment.selection: No sign, parameter, threshold or blend search; compare matched unconstrained control and current best.

real_raw_reconstruction_probe.scope: Observed nonnegative amounts changed while all other raw inputs and missingness remain fixed. Finite functional check, not causal evidence.

ctr_combination_source_check.finding: AddTreeCtrs rejects projections when GetFullProjectionLength exceeds MaxTensorComplexity. GetFullProjectionLength counts categorical features plus one if numerical binary or one-hot features are present; categorical-plus-numeric therefore needs at least2, so max_ctr_complexity1 excludes this path.
